'''House Silva''' is one of the founding bloodlines of [[Septimont]] and a once prominent noble family, though their influence began waver with the rise of the new [[Augusta|Ephor]]. 

During the most recent [[Great Agon]] the household and their head, Julia Silva, take part in match fixing and go as far as to sabotage [[Lupa]]'s equipment in the semi-final match after she leaves the household's gladiator team. After their sabotage is brought to Ephor Augusta and confirmed by Priestess [[Iuno]] they are banished from Septimont.

The house sponsored the gladiator team "Bough of Legions", which previously consisted of Lupa and [[Emilio]] prior to Lupa leaving.
